title: The end of a lawless paradise? Local government seeks to take back control of Corsican islet
subhead: Cavallo, a little gem of the Lavezzi archipelago, has always sparked envy. Once the scene of wild parties, it drew the international jet set before becoming a target for nationalists and organized crime groups. In June, the local government launched an offensive to regain control of the port and open the island up to tourists.

subhead: A scandal involving an employee of Sweden's Parliament has shaken the ruling alliance just ahead of the September 13 elections. The employee, who is the partner of a senior official of the Sweden Democrats party, faces accusations of spreading disinformation for Russia's benefit.

title: Far-right figure Bardella is uneasy about Le Pen's election platform on headscarves and pensions
subhead: In recent days, Jordan Bardella, the second-in-command of Marine Le Pen's far-right Rassemblement National party, has downplayed two of the party's most symbolic proposals and contradicted Le Pen on why one of his advisers quit.

title: At the Venice Film Festival, Julia Loktev moves audiences with story of Russian journalists in exile
subhead: In the second part of her documentary 'My Undesirable Friends,' the filmmaker immerses viewers in the lives of reporters forced to flee Russia abruptly, but who continue to inform their fellow citizens about the war in Ukraine in spite of the precarious conditions and ongoing intimidation.

subhead: Three sites, including one dedicated to the world of manga, may open in Val-d'Oise, just outside Paris. With €6 billion in investment and 22,000 jobs promised, the project has generated as much economic hope as it has concerns about the environment, housing and transportation.

title: Spanish fashion giant Mango: From small clothing shop to its founder's tragic death
subhead: In May, Jonathan Andic was arrested on suspicion of murdering his 71-year-old father, who fell to his death in a ravine in 2024. It was a shocking and tragic end for Isak Andic, a son of Turkish immigrants who turned a small second-hand clothing shop in Barcelona into a thriving textile empire over the course of nearly four decades.
